notes.title: Cannon Brawl blasts into Final Release!
notes.notes:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V9qKU-pt11Q

Today is the big day, Cannon Brawl is now 1.0! 

We’re really proud of what we’ve accomplished. Cannon Brawl is fun, looks fantastic, and explores new areas of design for strategy games. It’s everything we imagined it would be: full campaign, puzzle levels, and deep and competitive online multiplayer.

We've come a long way from the little prototype I made back in college. It won the Activision Independent Games Competition, which launched me and Theresa’s journey into full time indie game development as Turtle Sandbox. It was selected in the 2012 PAX 10, which helped get our name out there and was the first time we demoed it publicly. We launched our alpha in July of 2013 on Early Access, and today we’re now ready to call it done! Of course, we’ll still be supporting it with future patches and updates.

Huge thanks to everyone who played the Early Access builds, we got a ton of great feedback and it’s made the game better than we ever thought possible. It’s been great to have players who play the game at a higher level than we do and can help balance and tune in ways we couldn't have done on our own.

We’ll be streaming on Twitch from 12pm-8pm PST here: http://www.twitch.tv/cannonbrawlgame. Stop on by to join our celebration of launch day and see some exciting match ups in online multiplayer!

notes.title: Announcing Cannon Brawl's Final Release Date - Sept 19th!
notes.notes:
After over a year of improvements, fixing, and tuning we're locking down a final release date. On September 19th we'll be flipping the switch from Early Access to final release. 

We could not have done it without the help of all you Early Access players. Your feedback has been invaluable in making Cannon Brawl the best game it can be. 

We're also headed to PAX this year as part of the indie MEGABOOTH. Stop by if you're attending!

notes.title: Hot Patch - Build Notes 0.8.83 (1560)
notes.notes:
Looks like a crash was happening this morning after multiplayer matches because our stats server was responding slowly. This has just now been fixed, along with a bunch of other issues. 

I pushed this one out faster than normal because of the game breaking stats crash, so I didn't get to test as much internally as I normally would. Let me know about any and all issues in our Bugs and Support forum!

General Fixes:

 Fixed crash at end of game if it couldn’t upload stats
 Fixed crash if your desktop resolution was 1366x768
 More crash fixes in campaign, local multiplayer, and with a few buildings
 If Cannon Brawl crashes on load, if you run it again it will automatically switch to ‘old graphics card mode’.
 Fixed crash if you had a sound device disabled
 Fix volume increasing on settings UI menu after closing it


Gameplay Fixes:

 Made it less likely to get matched against the same person if they drop out before the battle begins
 Attempt fix on issue where it was possible to join a ‘zombie lobby’ in which you were matched with someone who was in a lobby but no longer playing.
 Drills can now pop territory balloons consistently
 Fixed issue where upgrading during a bribe switch your target to the enemy HQ rather than the intended target.
 Added a sound effect to notify you when a game has started
 Warhead can now be repaired in the air by the prince and repair center


Tuning:

 Drill Tower life increased from 12/15/20 to 15/20/25
 Decreased missile tower life from 20/25/30 to 15/20/25
